name.label: Name
name.helper: Internal name of the workflow step.

probe.label: Condition
probe.helper: Condition that must hold for the task to be created.

probeArg.label: Condition argument
probeArg.helper: Only for conditions taking an argument. For “event detail is …” write field=value, e.g. resourceType=boathouse

responsibilityKey.label: Responsibility
responsibilityKey.helper: Key of the responsibility that receives the task
responsibilityKey.subject: Person concerned (e.g. the task's author)

messageKey.label: Message (i18n key)
messageKey.helper: The {name} placeholder is replaced with the member's name

action.label: Action
action.helper: What happens when the rule matches.

actionArg.label: Action argument
actionArg.helper: Email: template · Signature: storage path · Approval: type of approval

writeBack.label: Update field
writeBack.helper: The field the decision sets on the record. Only approved combinations are possible.

steps.label: Actions
steps.helper: The actions run one after the other.
